name: Fleet Maintenance Predictor
desc: Scores every vehicle and machine from service intervals, fault codes, oil samples, defect reports and past breakdowns, books the riskiest work and tag-outs into the workshop first, and ranks likely causes of a fault with a draft work order you can book straight into the plan.
notes: Ten made-up vehicles and plant (three High, four Medium, three Low risk) are scored by sample rules from interval used, fault codes, oil samples, defect reports and breakdowns in the last year to predict when each part needs work and fill a four-week workshop plan (tag-outs and high risk first, one visit per vehicle with nearby work bundled), while AI explains asset health, ranks likely fault causes using the repair history, drafts the work order and plan note, and the repair can be booked into the plan; tag-out is given only for reported brake, steering or hydraulic faults (PL-201 and TK-120, not CR-009), it falls back to a sample fault code library when AI is off, operator names are removed before AI, intervals, codes, history, capacity and costs are samples, and Steps to productionise and Draft in Outlook were added.
tested: Smoke at 1280 light and 390 dark (no page or console errors, scrollWidth equals viewport, Steps to productionise panel opens, Draft in Outlook link on work order and plan note); rules mode: health summary, diagnose and book repair for TK-120 (tag-out, Priority 1, booked Tue), CR-009 not tag-out, empty-input error, plan note; mocked AI: health, diagnose and plan note use cache false, malformed output and a note that drops vehicles fall back to rules with a plain message, no operator names in prompts. Calibration kept at 3 High, 4 Medium, 3 Low.
